title: APT28: від первинного ураження до створення загроз для контролеру домену за годину (CERT-UA#8399)

entities.name: APT28
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage group affiliated with the GRU.

entities.name: MASEPIE
entities.gloss: A Python-based backdoor malware capable of downloading and uploading files and executing commands.

entities.name: OPENSSH
entities.gloss: An open-source suite of secure networking utilities based on the SSH protocol.

entities.name: STEELHOOK
entities.gloss: A PowerShell script designed to steal browser credentials and DPAPI master keys.

entities.name: OCEANMAP
entities.gloss: A C#-based backdoor malware that executes commands via cmd.exe and communicates over IMAP.

entities.name: IMPACKET
entities.gloss: A collection of Python classes for working with network protocols.

entities.name: SMBEXEC
entities.gloss: A post-exploitation tool used to execute commands remotely on Windows systems via SMB.

entities.name: Chrome
entities.gloss: A web browser developed by Google.

entities.name: Edge
entities.gloss: A web browser developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Client.py
entities.gloss: A Python script file containing MASEPIE malware code.

entities.name: 2.ps1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell script file associated with STEELHOOK malware.

entities.name: VMSearch.exe
entities.gloss: An executable payload associated with OCEANMAP backdoor malware.

entities.name: VMSearch.sfx.exe
entities.gloss: A self-extracting archive executable containing the OCEANMAP backdoor.
